title: Flink: Fix microsecond truncation for timestamps in arrays and maps (#18001)
claims: PR merged into main at the recorded event_date; no release inclusion was verified.
StructRowData timestamp conversion now preserves microseconds before splitting epoch milliseconds and nano-of-millisecond.
Patch updates Flink 1.20, 2.1, 2.2 and 2.3 source paths; the added array regression includes timestamps before and after the Unix epoch.

title: Parquet Page Index: Layout to Support Page Skipping
claims: Page index is optional ColumnChunk metadata; ColumnIndex locates candidate pages by values, and OffsetIndex maps row indexes to corresponding pages in other columns.
Page index separates page-level metadata so selective scans need not access every data page header before deciding which pages to skip.
Used only as format background; the three-page example is an author-created hypothetical layout, not a benchmark or new feature announcement.
